description: OpenClaw's retired npm names, clawdbot and moltbot, installed on Linux.
why: The npm route on Linux for the two names 56-openclaw-retired-names proves on macOS. Each package is its own witness, pinned by its row. `pi` is forbidden because OpenClaw is built on Pi's libraries: npm -g nests them, so installing OpenClaw must not read as Pi.
known_gaps: Installed with --ignore-scripts and never run: the rows prove the packages are present, not that the retired builds still start.
